packageRules.description: engines.node is a range kept by hand; the Node version itself lives in .nvmrc and the Dockerfile.
New majors of these wait for an ADR 0005 update; approve them from the dependency dashboard.
Any pg-boss update can change its schema version, and the migrate step refuses a version it has no upgrade path for (ADR 0005); approve every pg-boss update from the dependency dashboard.
prBodyNotes: Check whether `pgboss.schema` in pg-boss's `package.json` changes. A new schema version needs an upgrade path in `packages/db/src/queue/migrate-queue.ts` before this can merge.
